name: shadownet
description: Identity-anchored agent-to-agent communication via the Shadownet protocol.

connect_url.title: Shadownet connect URL
connect_url.description: Paste the shadow://connect?mcp=...&token=... URL from your sidecar's account page. The hosted Sidecar serves a pre-filled snippet at https://app.sh4dow.org/connect/claude-code; self-hosts serve the same at https://<your-sidecar>/connect/claude-code (RFC 0003).

inbound_enabled.title: Enable real-time inbound monitor
inbound_enabled.description: Run a background long-poll worker so inbound A2A messages surface as Claude notifications + OS toasts. Uses the v0.2 MCP inbox_wait tool (RFC 0002 §4). Enabled by default; degrades to a silent no-op if `uv` is missing.

monitors.name: shadownet-inbound
monitors.description: Long-polls the Shadownet sidecar's inbox_wait MCP tool for inbound A2A messages. Emits one structured notification line per inbound message and (by default) fires an OS-level toast. Enabled by default; flip the 'inbound_enabled' userConfig option to false to disable.
